title: Test bench function.eval: request
description: One call of a pure core function by name, without a record and without side effects. input is the function's input as a decision table case writes it (conformance/runner.md, section Decision table). Test bench port only.

function.description: governance.count: the rounds of one removal case from the snapshot and the ballots (GOV-8). commission.calibration: the calibration of a lens executor from its reviews and outcomes (COM-11). digest.sample: the monthly audit sample from the verdicts, the settings and the seed (DIG-5). reporter.number_check: the number check of a paragraph against a table snapshot and a locale (REP-4). schedule.check: the slot check of a schedule change for one year (TIM-5).

input.description: The function's input: the given of a decision table case, with the same field names.
input.x-botaru-closed-by: the input of the named function, as the decision table of conformance/runner.md writes it
